title: Chapter XXIII
focus: the wedding night and its catastrophe

teacherSummary.text: At the inn at Evian, Victor, pistol in hand, sends Elizabeth to bed while he searches the house; he then hears her scream and finds her murdered. He sees the creature grinning at the window and fires, but it escapes into the lake. Victor returns to Geneva, where his father dies of grief within days. Victor is confined for months as a madman; on release he tells his story to a Genevan magistrate, who listens with half-belief but doubts anything can be done, and Victor vows to pursue the creature himself.
